title: Will the number of full-width New York Times front page headlines be at least 1 in Oct 2026?
rules: If the number of New York Times front page banner headlines is at least 1 in Oct 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

This market resolves based on the front page displayed in the NYT Store's 'Front Page Reprint' section.
"Banner headline" refers to a standalone centered headline surrounded only by whitespace.

Past examples: Jan 5, 2026; Jan 4, 2026; Nov 5, 2025; May 31, 2024; Jun 24, 2016

blind.reasoning: The NYT runs full-width banner headlines only for major news, roughly a few times a year, so any given month has maybe a 20-35% chance. October 2026 has no scheduled mega-event because the midterm results will land in November, and about two-thirds of the month seems to have passed without a banner I could find, though my search was very limited. That leaves a surprise in the remaining ~10 days or an early-October banner I missed as the main ways to YES.
blind.falsifier: An NYT Store front-page reprint for any October 2026 date showing a standalone, centered, full-width banner headline, e.g., for a sudden war escalation, the death of a major world figure, or a large disaster.

final.reasoning: The midpoint (0.255) is only slightly above my estimate, and the wide spread means buying NO at about 0.79 has essentially no edge. The market may also reflect early-October events I couldn't check, so I nudge my estimate toward it and pass.
